_doc: Static supply currents of the tube cells per pin state, mA (doc/vtube_power.md). Read by rtl/run/vtube_power.py.
The heater current is not here: it is heat_current of vtube_cells.lib (one source). Edges are not modelled:
a tube cell draws its current while it conducts, and C*V^2*f of the nets is below 0.1 mW per net.
rails: the supply lines of the report; v is the rail voltage, the power is |v| * I.
cells.<CELL>.pins: the pins the state is made of, in VCD order of the table (the cell scope in the netlist VCD).
cells.<CELL>.states: [condition, {rail: value}], the first true condition wins; conditions and values are
Python expressions of the pins (0/1). No condition true: zero. A pin at x/z: the mean over all states.
status: spice (numbers of the cell page), derived (built from the pages of the sub-cells), estimate (no SPICE).
Divider currents: DIV_HL (470k / 200k to -50 V, one per HV net and grid class, synt_dpc.tcl -div). With the
load grids clamping a 1 near 0 V: 150/470k = 0.32 mA from the plate, 50/200k = 0.25 mA into -50 V; a 0 (50 V)
is not clamped: 100/670k = 0.15 mA through both. The plate share comes from +150 V through the plate resistor.

NOT_N16.src: NOT_N16/README.md, Power per tube: 9.5 mA per half whose output is low

NOR2_N16.src: NOR2_N16/README.md, Power per gate: 9.5 mA one input high, 11 mA both

NOR3_N16.src: NOR3_N16/README.md, Static operating points: 9.43 / 2 x 5.53 / 3 x 3.95 mA

NOR4_N16.src: NOR4_N16/README.md, Static operating points: 9.43 / 2 x 5.53 / 3 x 3.95 / 4 x 3.08 mA

NAND2_J2.src: NAND2_J2/README.md, Screen resistor table: AB=10 Ig2 5.4; AB=11 Ia 7.0, Ig2 4.4 mA

A1OOI_N16J2.src: A1OOI_N16J2/README.md, Static operating points (pentode Ik/Ia, triode Ik)

AOI211_J2N16.src: AOI211_J2N16/README.md, Static operating points (pentode Ik/Ia, each triode Ik)

A2OOI_J2.src: A2OOI_J2/README.md, Static operating points: one term Ik 11.3 / Ia 7.0, both Ik 9.2 / Ia 4.4, g1 high g3 low 5.46 mA to the screen
states: A and B and C and D

LATCH_J2N16.src: RSLATCH_J2N16/README.md (Datasheet limits and power): E low and S or R high: plate 9.2 + screen 5.4; E high, set or reset: pentode 6.3 + triode 5.0, screen 4.5 mA. S = D, R = ~D: one of them is always high. D inverter (half 6N16B) 9.5 mA at D = 1. Feedback and inverter dividers: about 0.7 / 0.6 mA

DFF_J2N16.src: DFF_J2N16/README.md: two RSLATCH (master E = C, slave E = ~C, so one latch is always open: 11.3 + 9.2 mA plate, 4.5 + 5.4 mA screen) + one 6N16B (D and C inverters, 9.5 mA each while its input is 1); four divider pairs ~1.9 / 1.6 mA

DFFP_J2N16.src: DFFP2_J2N16/README.md, Datasheet limits and power: per flip-flop triode 9.2, screen 6.6 mA static; inverter half 9.5 mA at D = 1; D pin divider 1.2 mA at D = 1. The 200 ns clock pulse (~23 mA) is left out

KEYDB_N16.src: KEYDB_N16/README.md: an Eccles-Jordan bistable, one triode always on (taken as NOT_N16: 9.5 mA), two dividers

GUIDE_EN_J2.src: DEKATRON_A110/README.md §9.3: guide key, 6Zh2B, Ra 10k to the key rail S (+50 V idle) -> ~4 mA with the plate at ~10 V; screen as NAND2_J2

GLIFT_N16.src: DEKATRON_A110/README.md §9.3: follower of the key rail S (+50 V idle, +150 V during write/reset); no sheet: assumed cathode load 22k to -50 V

WRCH_N16.src: DEKATRON_A110/README.md §9.4: write tube open (all the time except a write), 2.3 mA from +150 V through Rp 62k into -50 V

RDD_X7.src: vtube_cells.lib RDD_X7: grid pulled up by 100k; the diode conducts on an unlit line (-13 V): ~0.18 mA into the line and on to -50 V

BUF_N16.src: BUF_N16/README.md, Power per tube: 5.4 mA at Y = 1, 2.6 mA at Y = 0, plate to +150 V, Rk to -50 V

DEKATRON_A110.src: doc/a110_datasheet.md: anode current 0.7-0.9 mA from > 350 V; the cathode current returns through the write tube to -50 V
